title: Report fuel prices to the price reporting system
what: As a registered fuel retailer, report each relevant fuel's standard retail price on the fuel price reporting website.

laws.title: Australian Consumer Law (Tasmania) (Code of Practice for Fuel Price Reporting) Regulations 2020 (Tas)

sources.title: Australian Consumer Law (Tasmania) (Code of Practice for Fuel Price Reporting) Regulations 2020 (Tas)
sources.quote: A fuel retailer registered in accordance with clause 2 must report, on the fuel price reporting website, the standard retail price of each of the relevant fuels offered for sale by the fuel retailer
